key.name: toggle-keybinding
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the launcher
key.description: An array of accelerator strings; the first one opens the Spotlight modal.

key.name: enabled-providers
key.description: Provider identifiers that participate in a search.

key.name: max-results
key.description: Upper bound on the number of results returned for a single query.

key.name: preview-enabled
key.description: Whether the result preview column is rendered.

key.name: clipboard-enabled
key.description: Whether the local clipboard history provider is registered and records copied text.

key.name: usage-history
key.description: JSON map of "<providerId>:<id>" to {"count": n, "lastUsed": epoch-ms}.

key.name: currency-rates
key.description: JSON object with base, rates and asOf fields.

key.name: open-on-monitor
key.description: One of pointer, focused or primary.

key.name: files-source
key.description: One of auto, tracker or locate. `auto` queries the local Tracker/localsearch index together with the daemon path index (for git repositories Tracker ignores) and falls back to locate when neither is available.

key.name: extra-index-roots
key.summary: Additional roots for the daemon path index
key.description: Directories scanned by gnome-spotlightd's own path index. `$HOME` is expanded by the daemon. Tracker ignores git repositories, so these roots supplement its results.

key.name: path-index-max-entries
key.summary: Maximum number of path index entries
key.description: Hard cap for the daemon path index. The preferences slider exposes 50000-500000 entries; the daemon falls back to 200000 when the key is missing.

key.name: remote-providers-enabled
key.summary: Consume GNOME Shell native search providers
key.description: Query org.gnome.Shell.SearchProvider2 services discovered in the gnome-shell/search-providers directories (Settings, Calculator, Nautilus, Contacts, ...).
